references.text: The Lord speaks directly to Moses with the formula 'the Lord said to me', which is repeated throughout Deuteronomy
The context of Israel's journey around Edom's territory, where the Lord gives instructions on how they should relate to neighboring peoples
Continuation of the Lord's instructions to Moses on how Israel should relate to Moab
The same introductory formula is used when the Lord gives new instructions to Moses
God speaks to Moses with a similar formula, showing God's direct communication with His servant
